# telnyx_sim_card_set_standby (Action)

Puts a SIM card on standby, so it can connect once it is used. The SIM card must be in a SIM card group.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sim_card_id` (String) The sim card id.
